content: No established academic or industry standard exists for ranking DAW parameter expressiveness/automation salience from observed movement. Practitioner literature (MusicRadar, mind-flux Serum 2 macro tutorials 2025-2026) consistently shows producers pick macro targets by MOVEMENT: filter cutoff, FX mix, wavetable position, reverb decay — parameters that visibly evolve during performance. This validates the locked D-05-01 evidence model (observed live movement counts/variance, explicit user-exposed macro knobs rank top). Salience formula must be first-principles: movement count, value variance/range, distinct sections where movement occurred, role/energy-context prior boosts. No library to adopt; pure TS statistics (count, variance, range) suffice.
